biography.plain_text: Wolfgang Jahl is an Austrian businessman whose M.A.D. group supplies biodiesel and chemical products from Traun, Upper Austria. He was a founding shareholder and manager of its predecessor, Korona Filtertechnik, in 2000. He owns the group through a private holding company and shares management of the trading business with Mathias Jahl.

long_biography.plain_text:
Fuel trader Wolfgang Jahl's M.A.D. group invested in railway equipment to change how it transported fuel between storage terminals. The business replaced rented wagons with its own aluminium tank cars, increasing their payload and reducing the risk of rust contaminating cargo. Its dual-mode locomotives use overhead electricity where available and switch power sources to reach terminals without changing engines.

Jahl also worked with renewable-fuels adviser Rainer Präsoll on customer meetings and commercial projects. Their collaboration began with a discussion of Präsoll's book about biodiesel. They subsequently visited major customers together, while a separate project drew on the adviser's experience in media and advertising.
